abby: Heads-up - during pre-close QA I found several invoices where promo discounts were applied but the revenue schedule flipped to ratable_6mo instead of one_time. Affects three invoices.

nick: Invoice IDs?

abby: INV-4501001, INV-4501012, INV-4501019. Total delta approx $22,800. Pulled from reports/invoice_run_2026-06-30.csv.

finance-bot: Auto-ticket FIN-7010 created for INV-4501001, INV-4501012, INV-4501019.

nick: Likely cause is the pricing-experiments feature flag we toggled 06/28 that added promo_category mapping. It might be defaulting to ratable schedules for promo_category='trial-plus'.

abby: Agreed. For close we should reverse any deferrals and post one-time recognition. Draft JE: DR 2100 DeferredRevenue 22800 / CR 4000 AR 22800 then DR 6000 ContraRevenue 22800 / CR 4000 AR 22800 dated 06/30.

revenue-ops: Approve JE for <$25k. Please include memo: "FIN-7010 promo mapping misassigns rev_schedule; reversing deferrals for affected invoices." Also add change request to require staging billing run on experiment toggles.

nick: I'll revert feature-flag mapping in staging, run a dry billing-run, and add a unit check to assert promo invoices do not receive ratable schedules.

abby: Posted JE in GL (draft JE-80321). Waiting for final posting after staging check.

finance-bot: FIN-7010 updated: status=in_review je=JE-80321.

nick: Staging dry-run complete - mapping fix works. No new ratable assignments for promo_category='trial-plus'.

abby: Posted and posted JE-80321 in GL. FIN-7010 resolved. Adding month-close QA step: sample 5 promo invoices >5k to verify schedule.

finance-bot: FIN-7010 updated: status=resolved resolution="mapping revert + JE".

abby: Thanks team. Closing thread once quarterly close submission uploads.
